name: Sabinosuchus
isnote: PBDB places it in Pholidosauridae while its naming paper's title calls it a dyrosaurid (Schiller et al. 2016, as cited in English Wikipedia); check.
sum: Sabinosuchus is a mesoeucrocodylian from the Maastrichtian Escondido Formation of Coahuila, Mexico, named as a dyrosaurid.
wsnote: The sources consulted do not give the body length.
holotype: Catalogue number not given in the sources consulted.
material: One occurrence in the Escondido Formation.
biology: The sources consulted give no evidence of diet or habits.
author: Schiller et al. 2016
